(Then enters <s>Cārvāka</s>, a <s>rākṣasa</s> (demon) in the guise of an ascetic.)

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
*ātmagatam**
eṣo 'smi cārvāko nāma rākṣasaḥ / suyodhanasya mitraṃ pāṇḍavānvañcayituṃ bhramāmi* /prakāśam**
tṛṣito 'smi / saṃbhāvayatu māṃ kaścijjalacchāyāpradānena* /iti rājñaḥ samīpamupasarpati**
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] (aside) I am the <s>rākṣasa</s> named <s>Cārvāka</s>. A friend of <s>Suyodhana</s>, I wander about to deceive the <s>Pāṇḍavas</s>. (aloud) I am thirsty! Let someone honor me with the gift of water and shade! (approaches the king)
(all rise)
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] O sage, I salute you!
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] This is not the time for courtesies. Honor me with the gift of water.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] O sage, here is a seat. Please be seated.
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] (sitting down) Pray, do you also take a seat.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] (sitting down) Who is there? Ho! Bring water.
(enters carrying a water-pitcher)
[<s>Kañcukī</s>:] (approaching) Great King, this pitcher is filled with cool, fragrant water, and here is a drinking vessel.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] O sage, please remedy your thirst.
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] (washing his feet, sipping water, then reflecting) Ho! I think you are a <s>kṣatriya</s> (warrior).
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] You discern well, revered one. I am indeed a <s>kṣatriya</s>.

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
sulabhaśca svajanavināśaḥ saṃgrāmeṣu pratidinamato nādeyaṃ bhavadbhyo jalādikam / bhavatu / chāyayaivānayā sarasvatīśiśirataraṃgaspṛśā marutā cānena vigataklamo bhaviṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] The destruction of one's own people is commonplace in battles, day after day; therefore offerings of water and such should not be given to the likes of you. But enough. With this shade alone, and this breeze that touches the cool waves of the <s>Sarasvatī</s>, I shall be freed of my weariness.
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 167) O wise one, fan the great sage with this palm-leaf fan.
[Sanskrit rendering 167:] O wise one, fan the great sage with this palm-leaf fan.
(The maidservant does so.)
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] Lady, this courtesy is unfitting for one like me.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] O sage, tell us, how have you become so exhausted?

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
munijanasulabhena kautūhalena tatrabhavatāṃ mahākṣatriyāṇāṃ dvandvayuddhamavalokayituṃ paryaṭāmi samantapañcakam / adya tu balavattayā śaradātapasyāparyāptamevāvalokya gadāyuddhamarjunasuyodhanayorāgato 'smi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] With the curiosity natural to ascetics, I have been wandering about <s>Samantapañcaka</s> (Kurukṣetra) to witness the single combat of those great warriors. Today, however, overpowered by the intense heat of the autumn sun, having observed sufficiently the mace-fight of <s>Arjuna</s> and <s>Suyodhana</s>, I have come here.
(all display distress)
[<s>Kañcukī</s>:] O sage, surely not so! Say rather 'of <s>Bhīma</s> and <s>Suyodhana</s>.'
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] Ah! How can you reproach me when you yourself are ignorant of the events?
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Great sage, speak, speak!

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
kṣaṇamātraṃ viśramya sarvaṃ kathayāmi bhavato na punarasya vṛddhasya /
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] Let me rest a moment; I shall tell everything to you — but not to this old man.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Speak — do you mean of <s>Arjuna</s> and <s>Suyodhana</s>?

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
nanu pūrvameva kathitaṃ mayā pravṛttaṃ gadāyuddhamiti /
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] Did I not already say that a mace-fight has commenced?
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Not of <s>Bhīma</s> and <s>Suyodhana</s>?
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] That is over.
(<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s> and <s>Draupadī</s> fall into a swoon.)
[<s>Kañcukī</s>:] (sprinkling water) Let the lord and the queen take heart!
[Maidservant:] (Prakrit 168) Let the queen take heart! Let the queen take heart!
[Sanskrit rendering 168:] Let the queen take heart! Let the queen take heart!
(Both regain consciousness.)
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] What are you saying, O sage — that the mace-fight between <s>Bhīma</s> and <s>Suyodhana</s> is over?
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 169) Venerable one, speak, speak — what has happened?
[Sanskrit rendering 169:] Venerable one, speak, speak — what has happened?
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] Chamberlain, who are these two?
[<s>Kañcukī</s>:] O Brahmin, this is the lord <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>, and this is the daughter of the <s>Pāñcāla</s> king.
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] Ah! What a cruel thing I, the heartless one, have begun!
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 170) Alas, my lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>! (falls into a swoon)
[Sanskrit rendering 170:] Alas, my lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>!
[<s>Kañcukī</s>:] What exactly has been said?
[Maidservant:] (Prakrit 171) Let the queen take heart! Let the queen take heart!
[Sanskrit rendering 171:] Let the queen take heart! Let the queen take heart!
VERSE 6.14
'In this very matter of doubt, <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s> sits in grief;
if the truth of my dear one's [fate] is settled, this man [would be] happy even through the abandonment of life.' // 6.14 //
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] (with tears) O Brahmin,

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
*sānandamātmagatam**
atraiva me yatnaḥ* /prakāśam**
yadi tvavaśyaṃ kathanīyaṃ tadā saṃkṣepataḥ kathayāmi / na yuktaṃ bandhuvyasanaṃ vistareṇāvedayitum /
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] (aside, with delight) This is exactly what I am striving for! (aloud) If it must indeed be told, then I shall tell it briefly. It is not proper to report the calamity of kinsmen at length.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] (shedding tears)
VERSE 6.15
Tell me in any way, O <s>Brahman</s>, whether briefly or at length;

children.text: vatsasya kimapi śrotumeṣa dattaḥ kṣaṇo mayā // 6.15 //
children.translated_text: I have granted this moment to hear whatever there is about my dear one. // 6.15 //
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] Listen! VERSE 6.16 — In that battle between the <s>Kaurava</s> and <s>Bhīma</s>, with the terrible sound of the heavy maces,
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 172) (suddenly rising) Then? Then?
[Sanskrit rendering 172:] Then? Then?
VERSE 6.16
<s>Sīrin</s> (<s>Balarāma</s>) arrived in haste; the battle before him had lasted long.

children.text: ālambya priyaśiṣyatāṃ tu halinā saṃjñā rahasyāhitā $ yāmāsādya kurūttamaḥ pratikṛtiṃ duḥśāsanārau gataḥ // 6.16 //
children.translated_text: Having relied upon the affection of a beloved pupil, <s>Halin</s> (<s>Balarāma</s>) gave a secret signal, upon receiving which the best of the <s>Kurus</s> (<s>Duryodhana</s>) struck back at <s>Duḥśāsana</s>'s enemy (<s>Bhīma</s>). // 6.16 //
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] (aside) How can I now dispel the consciousness that these two have regained?
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Alas, dear <s>Vṛkodara</s>! (He falls into a swoon.)

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_173}hā ṇāha bhīmaseṇa hā maha paribhavapaḍiārapariccattajīvia jaḍāsurabaahiḍimbakimmīrakīcaajarāsaṃdhaṇisūdaṇa soandhiāharaṇacāḍuāra dehi me paḍivaaṇaṃ* /iti mohamupagatā**
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 173) Alas, my lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>! Alas, you who sacrificed your life to avenge my humiliation! O slayer of <s>Jaṭāsura</s>, <s>Baka</s>, <s>Hiḍimba</s>, <s>Kirmīra</s>, <s>Kīcaka</s>, and <s>Jarāsaṃdha</s>! O you who graciously brought the <s>Saugandhika</s> flowers! Give me an answer! (She falls into a swoon.)

children.text: SktCh_173: hā nātha bhīmasena hā mama paribhavapratīkāraparityaktajīvita jaṭāsurabakahiḍimbakirmīrakīcakajarāsaṃdhaniṣūdana saugandhikāharaṇacāṭukāra dehi me prativacanam /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 173:] Alas, lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>! Alas, you who sacrificed your life to avenge my humiliation! O slayer of <s>Jaṭāsura</s>, <s>Baka</s>, <s>Hiḍimba</s>, <s>Kirmīra</s>, <s>Kīcaka</s>, and <s>Jarāsaṃdha</s>! O you who graciously brought the <s>Saugandhika</s> flowers! Give me an answer!

children.text:
&kañcukī&:
*sāsram**
hā kumāra bhīmasena dhārtarāṣṭrakulakamalinīprāleyavarṣa* /sasaṃbhramam**
samāśvasitu mahārājaḥ / bhadre samāśvāsaya svāminīm / maharṣe tvamapi tāvadāśvāsaya mahārājam /
children.translated_text: [<s>Kañcukī</s> (chamberlain):] (tearfully) Alas, Prince <s>Bhīmasena</s>, you who are a hailstorm upon the lotus-pond of the <s>Dhārtarāṣṭra</s> clan! (with alarm) Let the great king compose himself! Good lady, comfort your mistress! Great sage, you too, please console the great king!

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
*svagatam**
āśvāsayāmi prāṇānparityājayitum* /prakāśam**
bho bhīmāgraja kṣaṇamekamādhīyatāṃ samāśvāsaḥ / kathāśeṣo 'sti /
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] (aside) I shall console them — so as to make them give up their lives. (aloud) O elder brother of <s>Bhīma</s>, gather your composure for just a moment! There remains more of the story.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] (recovering) Great sage, is there more to the story?

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_174}*pratibudhya sabhayam**
bhaavaṃ kadhehi kīdiso kadhāseso tti /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 174) (regaining consciousness, fearfully) Venerable one, tell us — what kind of remainder is there to the story?
[Sanskrit rendering 174:] Venerable one, tell us — what kind of remainder is there to the story?
[<s>Kañcukī</s>:] Tell us, tell us!

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
tataśca hate tasminsukṣatriye vīrasulabhāṃ gatimupagate samagrasaṃgalitaṃ bhrātṛvadhaśokajaṃ bāṣpaṃ pramṛjya bhrātṛvadhaśokādapahāya gāṇḍīvaṃ pratyagrakṣatajacchaṭācarcitāṃ tāmeva gadāṃ bhrātṛhastādākṛṣya nivāryamāṇo 'pi saṃdhitsunā vāsudevenāgacchāgaccheti sopahāsaṃ bhramitagadājhaṃkāramūrcchitagambhīravacanadhvanināhūyamānaḥ kauravarājena tṛtīyo 'nujaste kirīṭī yoddhumārabdhaḥ / akṛtinastasya gadāghātānnidhanamutprekṣamāṇena kāmapālenārjunapakṣapātī devakīsūnuratiprayatnātsvarathamāropya dvārakāṃ nītaḥ /
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] And then, when that noble <s>Kṣatriya</s> (<s>Bhīma</s>) was slain and had attained the destiny befitting a hero, wiping away the tears born of grief at his brother's death — which had streamed down all at once — setting aside the sorrow of his brother's death, taking up <s>Gāṇḍīva</s>, and seizing from his brother's hand that very mace, smeared with fresh spatters of blood — though restrained by <s>Vāsudeva</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>) who wished to negotiate peace — being summoned by the <s>Kaurava</s> king (<s>Duryodhana</s>) with the words 'Come, come!' accompanied by laughter and the deep resonance of his voice overwhelmed by the thunderous whirl of his mace — your third younger brother, <s>Kirīṭin</s> (<s>Arjuna</s>), began to fight! And <s>Kāmapāla</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>), foreseeing his death from the mace-blows of that ill-fated one, being partial to <s>Arjuna</s>, the son of <s>Devakī</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>) with great effort mounted him on his own chariot and took him away to <s>Dvārakā</s>.

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
sādhu bho arjuna tadaiva pratipannā vṛkodarapadavī gāṇḍīvaṃ parityajatā / ahaṃ punaḥ kenopāyena prāṇāpagamamahotsavamutsahiṣye /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Well done, O <s>Arjuna</s>! At that very moment you followed the path of <s>Vṛkodara</s> by abandoning <s>Gāṇḍīva</s>! But as for me, by what means shall I undertake the great festival of departing from life?

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_175}hā ṇāha bhīmasaṇa ṇa juttaṃ dāṇiṃ de kaṇīasaṃ bhādaraṃ asikkhidaṃ gadāe dāruṇassa sattuṇo ahimuhaṃ gacchantaṃ ubekkhiduṃ* /mohamupagatā**
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 175) Alas, lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>! It is not right for you now to have neglected your younger brother, untrained in mace-fighting, going to face a terrible enemy! (She falls into a swoon.)

children.text: SktCh_175: hā nātha bhīmasena na yuktamidānīṃ te kanīyāṃsaṃ bhrātaramaśikṣitaṃ gadāyāṃ dāruṇasya śatrorabhimukhaṃ gacchantamupekṣitum /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 175:] Alas, lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>! It is not right for you now to have neglected your younger brother, untrained in mace-fighting, going to face a terrible enemy!
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] And then I —

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
bhavatu mune kimataḥ paraṃ śrutena / hā tāta bhīmasena kāntāravyasanabāndhava hā maccharīrasthitivicchedakātara jatugṛhavipatsamudrataraṇayānapātra hā kirmīrahiḍimbāsurajarāsaṃdhavijayaikamalla hā kīcakasuyodhanānujakamalinīkuñjara hā dyūtapaṇapraṇayinhā madājñāsaṃpādaka hā kauravavanadāvānala

children.translated_text: VERSE 6.17

children.text: nirlajjasya durodaravyasanino vatsa tvayā sā tadā $ bhaktyā me samadadvipāyutabalenāṅgīkṛtā dāsatā &
children.translated_text: O dear one, that servitude which you then, out of devotion, with the strength of a full army of wild elephants, accepted on behalf of shameless me, addicted to the vice of gambling —

children.text: kiṃ nāmāpakṛtaṃ mayādhikamatastvayyadya yadgamyate ē̃ tyaktvā nātha sabāndhavaṃ sapadi māṃ prītiḥ kva te sādhunā // 6.17 //
children.translated_text: what greater wrong have I done to you that now you depart, O lord, suddenly abandoning me along with all my kinsmen — where is your affection for the virtuous? // 6.17 //

[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Enough, O sage! What more is there to hear? Alas, dear <s>Bhīmasena</s>, companion in the calamities of the wilderness! Alas, you who were anxious at the prospect of separation from my body! Alas, you who were the vessel for crossing the ocean of the lac-house disaster! Alas, you who were the sole champion in the victories over <s>Kirmīra</s>, <s>Hiḍimba</s>, the demon <s>Jarāsaṃdha</s>! Alas, you who were an elephant to the lotus-grove of <s>Kīcaka</s> and <s>Suyodhana</s>'s brother! Alas, you who lovingly fulfilled the stakes of the dice-game! Alas, you who carried out my commands! Alas, you who were a forest-fire to the forest of the <s>Kauravas</s>!
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 176) (regaining consciousness and rising) Great king, what is happening?
[Sanskrit rendering 176:] Great king, what is happening?
VERSE 6.18

He, the slayer of <s>Kīcaka</s>, the killer of <s>Baka</s>, <s>Hiḍimba</s>, and <s>Kirmīra</s>, the thunderbolt that shattered the union of the rut-maddened elephant that was the lord of <s>Magadha</s>,

children.text: gadāparighaśobhinā bhujayugena tenānvitaḥ ē̃ priyastava mamānujo 'rjunagururgato 'staṃ kila // 6.18 //
children.translated_text: endowed with a pair of arms resplendent with mace and iron bar — your beloved, my younger brother, the superior of <s>Arjuna</s>, has reportedly perished. // 6.18 //
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] <s>Kṛṣṇā</s>, what else [could it be]?

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_177}ṇāha bhīmaseṇa tue kila me kesā saṃamidavvā / ṇa juttaṃ vīrassa khattiassa paḍiṇṇādaṃ siḍhileduṃ / tā paḍibālehi maṃ jāva ubasappāmi* /punarmohamupagatā**
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 177) Lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>, it was you who were to braid my hair! It is not right for a heroic <s>Kṣatriya</s> to let his vow become slack. So wait for me while I approach you! (She falls into a swoon again.)

children.text: SktCh_177: nātha bhīmasena tvayā kila me keśāḥ saṃyamitavyāḥ / na yuktaṃ vīrasya kṣatriyasya pratijñātaṃ śithilayitum / tatpratipālaya māṃ yāvadupasarpāmi /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 177:] Lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>, it was you who were to braid my hair! It is not right for a heroic <s>Kṣatriya</s> to let his vow become slack. So wait for me while I approach you!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
*ākāśe**
amba pṛthe śruto 'yaṃ tava putrasya samudācāraḥ / māmekamanāthaṃ vilapantamutsṛjya kvāpi gataḥ / tāta jarāsaṃdhaśatro kiṃ nāma vaiparītyametāvatā kālenālpāyuṣi tvayi samālokitaṃ janena / atha vā mayaiva bahūpalabdham /

children.translated_text: VERSE 6.19

children.text: dattvā me karadīkṛtākhilanṛpāṃ yanmedinīṃ lajjase $ dyūte yacca paṇīkṛto 'pi hi mayā na krudhyasi prīyase &
children.translated_text: That you gave me a kingdom with all its kings made tributary, and felt ashamed; that even when I wagered you at dice, you did not grow angry but remained loving;

children.text: sthityarthaṃ mama matsyarājabhavane prāpto 'si yatsūdatāṃ ē̃ vatsaitāni vinaśvarasya sahasā dṛṣṭāni cihnāni // 6.19 //
children.translated_text: that for the sake of my survival you came to the house of the <s>Matsya</s> king and accepted the role of a cook — O dear one, these signs of one who was to perish were suddenly perceived [by me too late]. // 6.19 //

[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] (looking toward the sky) Mother <s>Pṛthā</s>, you have heard the conduct of your son! Abandoning me alone, without protector, lamenting — he has gone somewhere. Dear friend, O enemy of <s>Jarāsaṃdha</s>, what reversal of fortune has the world witnessed in you, who were so short-lived, in this brief span of time! Or rather, it is I who am most to blame.
(to the sage) What are you telling me? (He recites: 'In that battle between the <s>Kaurava</s> and <s>Bhīma</s>...' etc.)
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] It is exactly so.
VERSE 6.20

children.text: jñātiprītirmanasi na kṛtā kṣatriyāṇāṃ na dharmo $ rūḍhaṃ sakhyaṃ tadapi gaṇitaṃ nānujasyārjunena &
children.translated_text: No kinship-love was cherished in the heart, no <s>Kṣatriya</s> duty [observed]; the deep-rooted friendship was also disregarded — nor [was it honored] by <s>Arjuna</s> toward his younger brother;

children.text: tulyaḥ kāmaṃ bhavatu bhavataḥ śiṣyayoḥ snehabandhaḥ ē̃ ko 'yaṃ panthā yadasi vimukho mandabhāgye mayīttham // 6.20 //
children.translated_text: granted, let the bond of affection between your two pupils be equal — what then is this course [of action], that you are thus turned away from ill-fortuned me? // 6.20 //
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Cursed be our fortune! Venerable <s>Kāmapāla</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>), elder brother of <s>Kṛṣṇā</s>, brother of <s>Subhadrā</s> —

children.text:
*draupadīmupagamya**
ayi pāñcāli uttiṣṭha / samānaduḥkhāvevāvāṃ bhavāvaḥ / mūrcchayā kiṃ māmevamatisaṃdhatse /
children.translated_text: (approaching <s>Draupadī</s>) O <s>Pāñcālī</s>, arise! We two are alike in our grief. Why do you torment me further with your fainting?

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_178}*labdhasaṃjñā**
bandhedu ṇāho dujjohaṇarudhilāddeṇa hattheṇa dussāsaṇamukkaṃ me kesahatthaṃ / hañje buddhimadie tava paccakkhaṃ evva ṇāheṇa paḍiṇṇādaṃ* /kañcukinamupetya**
ajja kiṃ saṃdiṭṭhaṃ dāva me deveṇa devaīṇandaṇeṇa puṇo bi kesaraaṇā ārambhīadu tti / tā ubaṇehi me pupphadāmāiṃ / viraehi dāva kavariṃ / karehi bhaavado ṇārāaṇassa vaaṇaṃ / ṇa hu so alīaṃ saṃdisadi / aha vā kiṃ mae saṃtattāe bhaṇidaṃ / aciragadaṃ ajjauttaṃ aṇugamissaṃ* /yudhiṣṭhiramupagamya**
mahārāa ādībaa me cidaṃ / tumaṃ bi khattadhammaṃ aṇuvaṭṭanto evva ṇāhassa jīviaharassa ahimuho hohi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 178) (regaining consciousness) Let the lord bind my hair-braid, released by <s>Duḥśāsana</s>, with a hand wet with <s>Duryodhana</s>'s blood! My dear <s>Buddhimatī</s>, it was promised by the lord right before your eyes! (approaching the chamberlain) Sir, has my lord, the son of <s>Devakī</s>, sent word that the braiding of the hair should be begun again? Then bring me flower garlands! Arrange the braid! Carry out the word of the blessed <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>! For he does not give false commands! Or rather, what have I, distressed as I am, said? I shall soon follow my departed noble husband. (approaching <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>) Great king, light my funeral pyre! You too, following the <s>Kṣatriya</s> duty, go forth to face the one who has taken the lord's life!

children.text: SktCh_178: badhnātu nātho duryodhanarudhirārdreṇa hastena duḥśāsanamuktaṃ me keśahastam / hañje buddhimatike tava pratyakṣameva nāthena pratijñātam / ārya kiṃ saṃdiṣṭaṃ tāvanme devena devakīnandanena punarapi keśaracanārabhyatāmiti / tadupanaya me puṣpadāmāni / viracaya tāvatkabarīm / kuru bhagavato nārāyaṇasya vacanam / na khalu so 'līkaṃ saṃdiśati / atha vā kiṃ mayā saṃtaptayā bhaṇitam / aciragatamāryaputramanugamiṣyāmi / mahārāja ādīpaya me citām / tvamapi kṣatradharmamanuvartamāna eva nāthasya jīvitaharasyābhimukho bhava /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 178:] Let the lord bind my hair-braid, released by <s>Duḥśāsana</s>, with a hand wet with <s>Duryodhana</s>'s blood! My dear <s>Buddhimatī</s>, it was promised by the lord right before your eyes! Sir, has my lord, the son of <s>Devakī</s>, sent word that the braiding of the hair should be begun again? Then bring me flower garlands! Arrange the braid! Carry out the word of the blessed <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>! For he does not give false commands! Or rather, what have I, distressed as I am, said? I shall soon follow my departed noble husband. Great king, light my funeral pyre! You too, following the <s>Kṣatriya</s> duty, go forth to face the one who has taken the lord's life!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
yuktamāha pāñcālī / kañcukinkriyatāmiyaṃ tapasvinī citāsaṃvibhāgena sahyavedanā / mamāpi sajjaṃ dhanurupanaya / alamatha vā dhanuṣā /

children.translated_text: VERSE 6.21

children.text: tasyaiva deharudhirokṣitapāṭalāṅgī- $ mādāya saṃyati gadāmapavidhya cāpam &
children.translated_text: Taking up that very mace, its limbs reddened with the blood of his body, and casting aside the bow —

children.text: bhrātṛpriyeṇa kṛtamadya yadarjunena ē̃ śreyo mamāpi hi tadeva kṛtaṃ jayena // 6.21 //
children.translated_text: that which was done today by <s>Arjuna</s>, out of love for his brother, that same [course] is my glory too, done through victory. // 6.21 //

[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] <s>Pāñcālī</s> speaks rightly. Chamberlain, grant this suffering woman the comfort of sharing the funeral pyre — for she can endure the pain. And bring me my bow, ready [for battle]. Or rather, enough of the bow!

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
rājanripujayavimukhaṃ te yadi cetastadā yatra tatra vā prāṇatyāgaṃ kuru / vṛthā tatra gamanam /
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] O king, if your mind is averse to victory over the enemy, then give up your life anywhere you please. Going there [to the battlefield] would be futile.
[<s>Kañcukī</s>:] Shame on you, sage! Your heart is like that of a <s>Rākṣasa</s> (demon)!

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
*sabhayaṃ svagatam**
kiṃ jñāto 'hamanena* /prakāśam**
bhoḥ kañcukintayorgadayā khalu yuddhaṃ pravṛttamarjunaduryodhanayoḥ / jānāmi ca tayorgadāyāṃ bhujasāram / duḥkhitasya punarasya rājarṣeraparamaniṣṭaśravaṇaṃ pariharannevaṃ bravīmi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] (aside, with fear) Has he recognized me? (aloud) O chamberlain, the battle between those two — <s>Arjuna</s> and <s>Duryodhana</s> — has commenced with maces! And I know the strength of arms of both in mace-combat. But wishing to spare this grieving royal sage from hearing yet more dreadful news, I speak thus.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] (shedding tears) Well said, great sage, well said! You have spoken with much affection.

children.text:
&kañcukī&:
mahārāja kiṃ nāma śokāndhatayā devena devakalpenāpi prākṛteneva tyajate kṣātradharmaḥ /
children.translated_text: [<s>Kañcukī</s>:] Great king, why does the lord, though equal to a god, abandon the <s>Kṣatriya</s> duty like an ordinary man, blinded by grief?
VERSE 6.22
I shall not be able to see <s>Bhīma</s> and <s>Arjuna</s>, whose arms were thick as iron bars, who had displayed the essence of their valor in the cities of <s>Kubera</s> and <s>Indra</s>,

children.text: bhīmārjunau kṣititale praviceṣṭamānau ē̃ draṣṭuṃ tayośca nidhanena ripuṃ kṛtārtham // 6.22 //
children.translated_text: writhing upon the ground, and the enemy made triumphant by their death. // 6.22 //
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Noble <s>Jayaṃdhara</s> —

children.text: ayi pāñcālarājatanaye maddurnayaprāptaśocyadaśe yathā saṃdīpyate pāvakastathā sahitāveva bandhujanaṃ saṃbhāvayāvaḥ /
children.translated_text: O daughter of the <s>Pañcāla</s> king, O you who have been brought to a pitiable state by my evil counsel — just as a fire is kindled, so let us two together honor our kinsmen [by joining them in death].

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_179}ajja karehi dārusaṃcaaṃ / pajjalīadu aggī / tuvaradi me hiaaṃ ṇāhaṃ pekkhiduṃ* /sarvato dṛṣṭvā**
kahaṃ ṇa ko bi mahārāassa vaaṇaṃ karedi / hā ṇāha bhīmaseṇa taṃ evva edaṃ rāaulaṃ tue virahidaṃ pariaṇo vi saṃpadaṃ pariharadi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 179) Sir, prepare a heap of firewood! Let the fire blaze! My heart hastens to behold my lord! (looking around on all sides) Why does no one carry out the great king's command? Alas, lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>! This is that very royal household, bereft of you — even the attendants now abandon it!

children.text: SktCh_179: ārya kuru dārusaṃcayam / prajvālyatāmagniḥ / tvarate me hṛdayaṃ nāthaṃ prekṣitum / kathaṃ na ko 'pi mahārājasya vacanaṃ karoti / hā nātha bhīmasena tadevedaṃ rājakulaṃ tvayā virahitaṃ parijano 'pi sāṃprataṃ pariharati /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 179:] Sir, prepare a heap of firewood! Let the fire blaze! My heart hastens to behold my lord! Why does no one carry out the great king's command? Alas, lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>! This is that very royal household, bereft of you — even the attendants now abandon it!
[<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] This following of the husband [in death] is befitting the wives of the <s>Bharata</s> clan.

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
maharṣe na kaścicchṛṇoti tāvadāvayorvacanam / tadindhanapradānena prasādaḥ kriyatām /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Great sage, no one heeds the words of either of us. Therefore, kindly do us the favor of providing fuel.

children.text:
&rākṣasaḥ&:
munijanaviruddhamidam* /svagatam**
pūrṇo me manorathaḥ / yāvadanupalakṣitaḥ samindhayāmi vahnim* /prakāśam**
rājanna śaknumo vayamiha sthātum* /iti niṣkrāntaḥ**
children.translated_text: [<s>Rākṣasa</s>:] This is contrary to the ways of sages. (aside) My desire is fulfilled. Let me kindle the fire unnoticed. (aloud) O king, we cannot remain here. (He exits.)

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
kṛṣṇe na kaścidasmadvacanaṃ karoti / bhavatu / svayamevāhaṃ dārusaṃcayaṃ kṛtvā citāmādīpayāmi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] <s>Kṛṣṇā</s>, no one carries out our command. So be it — I myself shall prepare a heap of firewood and light the pyre.
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 180) Let the great king hasten! Let him hasten!
[Sanskrit rendering 180:] Let the great king hasten, hasten!
*A tumult offstage*

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_181}*sabhayamākarṇya**
mahārāa kassa bi eso baladappidassa visamo saṅkhaṇigghoso suṇīadi / abaraṃ bi appiaṃ suṇiduṃ atthi ṇibbandho tado vilambīadi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 181) *Listening with alarm* Great king, this terrible sound of a conch-shell is heard, belonging to someone intoxicated with strength. Moreover, there is insistence on hearing yet more unpleasant news, and so there is delay.

children.text: SktCh_181: mahārāja kasyāpyeṣa baladarpitasya viṣamaḥ śaṅkhanirghoṣaḥ śrūyate / aparamapyapriyaṃ śrotumasti nirbandhastato vilambyate /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 181:] Great king, this terrible sound of a conch-shell is heard, belonging to someone intoxicated with strength. Moreover, there is insistence on hearing yet more unpleasant news, and so there is delay.

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
na khalu vilambyate / uttiṣṭha* /iti sarve parikrāmanti**
ayi pāñcāli ambāyāḥ sapatnījanasya ca kiṃcitsaṃdiśya nivartaya parijanam /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] There is no delay indeed. Rise! *All walk about the stage* O <s>Pāñcālī</s>, give some instructions to the queen-mother and to the co-wives, and send back the attendants.

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_182}mahārāa ambāe evvaṃ saṃdisissaṃ / jo so baahiḍimbakimmīrajaḍāsurajarāsaṃdhavijaamallo de majjhamaputto so mama hadāsāe pakkhabādeṇa paraloaṃ gado tti /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 182) Great king, I shall tell the queen-mother thus: 'He who was the champion of victories over <s>Baka</s>, <s>Hiḍimba</s>, <s>Kirmīra</s>, <s>Jaṭāsura</s>, and <s>Jarāsandha</s> — your middle son — he, out of partiality toward me, who am bereft of hope, has gone to the other world.'

children.text: SktCh_182: mahārāja ambāyā evaṃ saṃdekṣyāmi / yaḥ sa bakahiḍimbakirmīrajaṭāsurajarāsaṃdhavijayamallaste madhyamaputraḥ sa mama hatāśāyāḥ pakṣapātena paralokaṃ gata iti /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 182:] Great king, I shall tell the queen-mother thus: 'He who was the champion of victories over <s>Baka</s>, <s>Hiḍimba</s>, <s>Kirmīra</s>, <s>Jaṭāsura</s>, and <s>Jarāsandha</s> — your middle son — he, out of partiality toward me, who am bereft of hope, has gone to the other world.'
VERSE 6.23

children.text: yenāsi tatra jatuveśmani dīpyamāne $ nirvāhitā saha sutairbhujayorbalena &
children.translated_text: By whom you were rescued there in the house of lac when it was ablaze, together with your sons, by the strength of his arms—

children.text: tasya priyasya balinastanayasya pāpa- ē̃ mākhyāmi te 'mba kathayetkathamīdṛganyaḥ // 6.23 //
children.translated_text: Of that dear, mighty son's death, O mother, I shall tell you; who else could relate such a thing? (6.23)
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Good lady, O <s>Buddhimatikā</s>, tell the queen-mother on our behalf:

children.text: ārya jayaṃdhara tvayāpi sahadevasakāśaṃ gantavyam / vaktavyaśca tatrabhavānpāṇḍukulabṛhaspatirmādreyaḥ kanīyānasmākam / sakalakurukulakamalākaradāvānalo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ paralokamabhiprasthitaḥ priyānujamapratikūlaṃ satatamāśaṃsanīyamasaṃmūḍhaṃ vyasane 'bhyudaye ca dhṛtimantaṃ bhavantamaviralamāliṅgya śirasi cāghrāyedaṃ prārthayate /

children.translated_text: VERSE 6.24

children.text: mama hi vayasā dūreṇālpaḥ śrutena samo bhavā- $ nsahajakṛtayā buddhyā jyeṣṭho manīṣitayā guruḥ &
children.translated_text: You are indeed far younger than me in age, equal in learning,

children.text: śirasi mukulau pāṇī kṛtvā bhavantamato 'rthaye ē̃ mayi viralatāṃ neyaḥ snehaḥ piturbhava vāridaḥ // 6.24 //
children.translated_text: Elder by innate wisdom, a preceptor in counsel; placing my cupped hands upon my head, I beseech you: let not the affection of a father, like a rain-cloud, grow sparse toward me. (6.24)

Noble <s>Jayaṃdhara</s>, you too must go to <s>Sahadeva</s>. And you should tell the revered <s>Mādrī</s>'s son, the <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (preceptor) of the <s>Pāṇḍu</s> clan, our youngest. <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>, who is the forest-fire to the lotus-lake of the entire <s>Kuru</s> clan, having set forth to the other world, embracing you closely — his dear younger brother, never opposing, always reliable, clear-minded in both adversity and prosperity, and resolute — and smelling your head, makes this request:

children.text: api ca bālye saṃvardhitasya nityābhimānino 'smatsadṛśahṛdayasārasyāpi nakulasya mamājñayā vacane sthātavyam / taducyatāṃ nakulaḥ / nānugantavyāsmatpadavī / tvayā hi vatsa

children.translated_text: VERSE 6.25
Forgetting us, with your wisdom bright as scripture, together with your younger brother, to offer funeral cakes to <s>Pāṇḍu</s>, water-drops mixed with tears,

children.text: dāyādānāmapi tu bhavane yādavānāṃ kule vā ē̃ kāntāre vā kṛtavasatinā rakṣaṇīyaṃ śarīram // 6.25 //
children.translated_text: Whether in the house of heirs, in the family of the <s>Yādavas</s>, or dwelling in the wilderness — your body must be preserved. (6.25)

And also, <s>Nakula</s> too — who was reared in childhood, always full of pride, with a heart equal to ours — must by my command abide by these words. So tell <s>Nakula</s>: Do not follow our path. For you, my son,
Go, <s>Jayaṃdhara</s>. Adjured by the touch of our body, you must without fail report this untimely [event].

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_183}halā buddhimadie bhaṇāhi mama vaaṇeṇa piasahiṃ subhaddaṃ / ajja vacchāe uttarāe cauttho māso paḍibaṇṇassa gabbhassa / tumaṃ evva edaṃ kulapaḍiṭṭhābaaṃ sāvahāṇaṃ rakkha / kadā bi ido paraloagadassa sasuraulassa amhāṇaṃ bi salilabindudo bhavissadi tti /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 183) Dear <s>Buddhimatikā</s>, tell my dear friend <s>Subhadrā</s> on my behalf: Today is the fourth month of the pregnancy of our dear daughter-in-law <s>Uttarā</s>. You alone must carefully protect this child who will restore our lineage. Someday, he will offer water-drops for the father-in-law's family that has gone to the other world, and for us too.

children.text: SktCh_183: halā buddhimatike bhaṇa mama vacanena priyasakhīṃ subhadrām / adya vatsāyā uttarāyāścaturtho māsaḥ pratipannasya garbhasya / tvamevaitaṃ kulapratiṣṭhāpakaṃ sāvadhānaṃ rakṣa / kadāpītaḥ paralokagatasya śvaśurakulasyāsmākamapi salilabindudo bhaviṣyatīti /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 183:] Dear <s>Buddhimatikā</s>, tell my dear friend <s>Subhadrā</s> on my behalf: Today is the fourth month of the pregnancy of our dear daughter-in-law <s>Uttarā</s>. You alone must carefully protect this child who will restore our lineage. Someday, he will offer water-drops for the father-in-law's family that has gone to the other world, and for us too.
VERSE 6.26
In a great tree with its earth-circle concealed by the expanse of its branches, adorned in every direction, with a massive trunk, and a well-proportioned great base spreading wide,

children.text: dagdhe daivātsumahati tarau tasya sūkṣmāṅkure 'smi- ē̃ nnāśābandhaṃ kamapi kurute chāyayārthī jano 'yam // 6.26 //
children.translated_text: Burnt by fate — in that tiny shoot of his, this people, seekers of shade, place some indefinable hope. (6.26)
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] *With tears* Alas, what misery!

children.text:
sādhu / idānīmadhyavasitaṃ karaṇīyam* /kañcukinamavalokya**
ārya jayaṃdhara svaśarīreṇa śāpito 'si tathāpi na gamyate /
children.translated_text: Good. Now what has been resolved must be done. *Seeing the chamberlain* Noble <s>Jayaṃdhara</s>, you have been adjured by my own body, yet you do not go!

children.text:
&kañcukī&:
*sākrandam**
hā deva pāṇḍo tava sutānāmajātaśatrubhīmārjunanakulasahadevānāmayaṃ dāruṇaḥ pariṇāmaḥ / hā devi kunti bhojarājabhavanapatāke

children.translated_text: VERSE 6.27

children.text: bhrātuste tanayena śauriguruṇā śyālena gāṇḍīvina- $ stasyaivākhiladhārtarāṣṭranalinīvyālolane dantinaḥ &
children.translated_text: By the preceptor of your brother, the weighty lord of <s>Śauri</s>'s clan, the brother-in-law, the wielder of <s>Gāṇḍīva</s>; by the chariot-like elephant of that very one, swaying across all the <s>Dhārtarāṣṭra</s> lotus-pond;

children.text: ācāryeṇa vṛkodarasya halinonmattena mattena vā ē̃ dagdhaṃ tvatsutakānanaṃ nanu mahī yasyāśrayācchītalā // 6.27 //
children.translated_text: By the teacher of <s>Vṛkodara</s>, by the maddened ploughman (<s>Balarāma</s>), or by the intoxicated one — the forest of your sons has been burnt, upon whose shelter the earth was cool. (6.27)

[Chamberlain:] *Weeping* Alas, lord <s>Pāṇḍu</s>, this is the terrible fate of your sons — <s>Ajātaśatru</s>, <s>Bhīma</s>, <s>Arjuna</s>, <s>Nakula</s>, and <s>Sahadeva</s>! Alas, queen <s>Kuntī</s>, banner of the <s>Bhoja</s> king's palace—
*Thus weeping, he exits*
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] <s>Jayaṃdhara</s>! <s>Jayaṃdhara</s>!
*Entering*
[Chamberlain:] Let the lord command.

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
vaktavyamiti bravīmi / na punaretāvanti bhāgadheyāni naḥ / yadi kadācidvijayī syādvatso 'rjunastadvaktavyo 'smadvacanādbhavatā /

children.translated_text: VERSE 6.28

children.text: halī hetuḥ satyaṃ bhavati mama vatsasya nidhane $ tathāpyeṣa bhrātā sahajasuhṛdaste madhuripoḥ &
children.translated_text: <s>Halin</s> (<s>Balarāma</s>) is truly the cause of our son's death;

children.text: ataḥ krodhaḥ kāryo na khalu yadi ca prāṇiṣi tato ē̃ vanaṃ gacchermā gāḥ punarakaruṇāṃ kṣātrapadavīm // 6.28 //
children.translated_text: Nevertheless, this brother is the innate companion of your <s>Madhusūdana</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>); therefore, anger should not be directed [at him]. And if you survive, then go to the forest; do not again tread the merciless path of the <s>Kṣatriya</s>. (6.28)
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] I say there is something to be told. Our fortunes are not so great. If perchance our son <s>Arjuna</s> should be victorious, then you should tell him on our behalf:
[Chamberlain:] As the lord commands. *He exits*

[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] *Seeing the fire, with joy* O <s>Kṛṣṇā</s> (<s>Draupadī</s>), the blazing lord <s>Hutāśana</s> (Fire), with upraised flame-hands, surely invites wretched ones like us! Therefore I shall make myself his fuel.

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_184}pasīdadu pasīdadu mahārāo mama imiṇā apacchimeṇa paṇaeṇa / ahaṃ dāva aggado pavisāmi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 184) May the great king be pleased, be pleased, by this my final act of love. Let me first enter the fire.

children.text: SktCh_184: prasīdatu prasīdatu mahārājo mamānenāpaścimena praṇayena / ahaṃ tāvadagrataḥ praviśāmi /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 184:] May the great king be pleased, be pleased, by this my final act of love. Let me first enter the fire.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] If so, then together we shall both enjoy the blessed departure.

children.text:
&ceṭī&:
{Pkt_185}hā bhaavanto loabālā parittāaha parittāaha / eso kkhu somavaṃsarāesī rāasūasaṃtappidahavvavāho khaṇḍavasaṃtappidahudavahassa kirīḍiṇo jeṭṭho bhādā sugihīdaṇāmaheo mahārāajuhiṭṭhiro / esā bi pañcālarāataṇaā devī jaṇṇavedimajjhasaṃbhavā jaṇṇaseṇī / duve bi ṇikkaruṇajalaṇassa ppaveseṇa indhaṇīhonti / tā parittāaha ajjā parittāaha / kadhaṃ ṇa ko bi parittāadi* /tayoragrataḥ patitvā**
kiṃ vavasidaṃ devīe deveṇa a /
children.translated_text: [Maidservant:] (Prakrit 185) Alas, O guardians of the world, save them, save them! This indeed is the emperor of the <s>Soma</s> dynasty, who fed the sacred fire with the <s>Rājasūya</s> sacrifice, the elder brother of <s>Kirīṭin</s> (<s>Arjuna</s>) who fed the fire-god with the <s>Khāṇḍava</s> [forest], the illustrious great king <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s> of renowned name! And this is the daughter of the <s>Pāñcāla</s> king, the queen born from the midst of the sacrificial altar, <s>Yājñasenī</s> (<s>Draupadī</s>). Both of them are about to become fuel by entering the merciless fire! So save them, noble ones, save them! Why does no one save them? *Falling before them* What have the queen and the king resolved?

children.text: SktCh_185: hā bhagavanto lokapālāḥ paritrāyadhvaṃ paritrāyadhvam / eṣa khalu somavaṃśarājarṣī rājasūyasaṃtarpitahavyavāhaḥ khāṇḍavasaṃtarpitahutavahasya kirīṭino jyeṣṭho bhrātā sugṛhītanāmadheyo mahārājayudhiṣṭhiraḥ / eṣāpi pāñcālarājatanayā devī yajñavedimadhyasaṃbhavā yājñasenī / dvāvapi niṣkaruṇajvalanasya praveśenendhanībhavataḥ / tatparitrāyadhvamāryāḥ paritrāyadhvam / kathaṃ na ko 'pi paritrāyate / kiṃ vyavasitaṃ devyā devena ca /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 185:] Alas, O guardians of the world, save them, save them! This indeed is the emperor of the <s>Soma</s> dynasty, who fed the sacred fire with the <s>Rājasūya</s> sacrifice, the elder brother of <s>Kirīṭin</s> who fed the fire-god with the <s>Khāṇḍava</s> [forest], the illustrious great king <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s> of renowned name! And this is the daughter of the <s>Pāñcāla</s> king, the queen born from the midst of the sacrificial altar, <s>Yājñasenī</s>. Both of them are about to become fuel by entering the merciless fire! So save them, noble ones, save them! Why does no one save them? What have the queen and the king resolved?

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
ayi buddhimatike yadvatsalena priyānujena vinā sadṛśaṃ tat / uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadre udakamupanaya /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] O <s>Buddhimatikā</s>, what befits one whose dear younger brother is lost is just this. Rise, rise, good lady! Bring water.

children.text:
&ceṭī&:
{Pkt_186}jaṃ devo āṇabedi* /iti niṣkramya punaḥ praviśya ca**
jedu jedu mahārāo /
children.translated_text: [Maidservant:] (Prakrit 186) As the lord commands. *Exiting and re-entering* Victory, victory to the great king!

children.text: SktCh_186: yaddeva ājñāpayati / jayatu jayatu mahārājaḥ /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 186:] As the lord commands. Victory, victory to the great king!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
pāñcāli tvamapi tāvatsvapakṣapātino vṛkodarasya priyasyārjunasyodakakriyāṃ kuru /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] <s>Pāñcālī</s>, you too now perform the water-offering for your beloved <s>Vṛkodara</s> (<s>Bhīma</s>) who favored you, and for dear <s>Arjuna</s>.

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_187}mahārāo evva karedu / ahaṃ puṇo jalaṇaṃ pavisissaṃ /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 187) Let the great king do it. I shall then enter the fire.

children.text: SktCh_187: mahārāja eva karotu / ahaṃ punarjvalanaṃ pravekṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 187:] Let the great king do it. I shall then enter the fire.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] The custom of the world must not be transgressed. Good lady, bring the water.
*The maidservant does so*

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
*pādau prakṣālyopaspṛśya ca**
eṣa tāvatsalilāñjalirgāṅgeyāya bhīṣmāya gurave / ayaṃ prapitāmahāya śāntanave / ayamapi pitāmahāya vicitravīryāya* /sāsram**
tātasyādhunāvasaraḥ / ayamapi tatrabhavate sugṛhītanāmne pitre pāṇḍave /

children.translated_text: VERSE 6.29
From this day forth, water such as this will be hard to obtain again from us;

children.text: tāta mādryambayā sārdhaṃ mayā dattaṃ nipīyatām // 6.29 //
children.translated_text: Father, together with mother <s>Mādrī</s>, drink this offered by me. (6.29)

[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] *Having washed his feet and performed <s>ācamana</s> (ritual sipping)* This first water-offering is for the grandfather, the venerable <s>Bhīṣma</s>, descendant of <s>Gaṅgā</s>, our preceptor. This one is for the great-grandfather, <s>Śāntanu</s>. This one too is for the grandfather <s>Vicitravīrya</s>. *With tears* Now it is the turn of father. And this one is for the revered one of renowned name, our father <s>Pāṇḍu</s>.
VERSE 6.30

children.text: etajjalaṃ jalajanīlavilocanāya $ bhīmāya tasya mama cāpyavibhaktamastu &
children.translated_text: Let this water be shared, undivided, between <s>Bhīma</s> of lotus-blue eyes and me;

children.text: ekaṃ kṣaṇaṃ virama vatsa pipāsito 'pi ē̃ pātuṃ tvayā saha javādayamāgato 'smi // 6.30 //
children.translated_text: Pause for one moment, my son, even though you are thirsty — I have come hastily to drink together with you. (6.30)

children.text: atha vā sukṣatriyāṇāṃ gatimupagataṃ vatsamahamupagato 'pyakṛtī draṣṭum / vatsa bhīmasena

children.translated_text: VERSE 6.31

children.text: mayā pītaṃ pītaṃ tadanu bhavatāmbāstanayugaṃ $ maducchiṣṭairvṛttiṃ janayasi rasairvatsalatayā &
children.translated_text: First I drank, then you drank from mother's pair of breasts;

children.text: vitāneṣvapyevaṃ tava mama ca some vidhirabhū- ē̃ nnivāpāmbhaḥ pūrvaṃ pibasi kathamevaṃ tvamadhunā // 6.31 //
children.translated_text: With my leftover juices you sustain your life through affection. At <s>Soma</s> sacrifices too, such was the ritual order for you and me — how is it that you drink the funeral water before me now? (6.31)
Or rather, having attained the destiny of true <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, I too, though unworthy, have come to behold my son. O son, <s>Bhīmasena</s>,
<s>Kṛṣṇā</s> (<s>Draupadī</s>), you too give the water-offering.
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 188) Dear <s>Buddhimatikā</s>, bring me water.

children.text: SktCh_188: hañje buddhimatike upanaya me salilam /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 188:] Dear <s>Buddhimatikā</s>, bring me water.
*The maidservant does so*

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_189}*upasṛtya jalāñjaliṃ pūrayitvā**
mahārāa kassa salilaṃ demhi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 189) *Approaching and filling her cupped hands with water* Great king, to whom shall I offer the water?
[Sanskrit rendering 189:] Great king, to whom shall I give the water?
VERSE 6.32

children.text: tasmai dehi jalaṃ kṛṣṇe sahasā gacchate divam /
children.translated_text: Give the water, O <s>Kṛṣṇā</s>, to him who hastily departs to heaven,

children.text: ambāpi yena gāndhāryā ruditena sakhī kṛtā // 6.32 //
children.translated_text: By whom even mother was made a companion of <s>Gāndhārī</s> in weeping. (6.32)
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:]

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_190}ṇāha bhīmaseṇa pariaṇobaṇīdaṃ udaaṃ saggagadassa de pādodaaṃ bhodu /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 190) O lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>, this water brought by the attendants — may it be the foot-washing water for you who have gone to heaven.

children.text: SktCh_190: nātha bhīmasena parijanopanītamudakaṃ svargagatasya te pādodakaṃ bhavatu /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 190:] O lord <s>Bhīmasena</s>, this water brought by the attendants — may it be the foot-washing water for you who have gone to heaven.
VERSE 6.33
With your vow unfulfilled, as you set like the sun, O mighty-armed one,
By your beloved, her hair still unbound, this water-offering has been given to you. (6.33)
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] O elder brother of <s>Phālguna</s> (<s>Arjuna</s>),
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 191) Rise, great king! Your brother is going far away.

children.text: SktCh_191: uttiṣṭha mahārāja dūraṃ gacchati te bhrātā /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering 191:] Rise, great king! Your brother is going far away.

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
*dakṣiṇākṣispandanaṃ sūcayitvā**
pāñcāli nimittāni me kathayanti saṃbhāvayiṣyasi vṛkodaramiti /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] *Indicating a throbbing of the right eye* <s>Pāñcālī</s>, the omens tell me that you shall see <s>Vṛkodara</s> again.
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] (Prakrit 192) Great king, may it be a good omen!
[Sanskrit rendering 192:] Great king, may it be a good omen!
*A tumult offstage*
*Entering in agitation*

children.text:
&kañcukī&:
paritrāyatāṃ paritrāyatāṃ mahārājaḥ / eṣa khalu durātmā kauravāpasadaḥ kṣatajābhiṣekapāṭalitāmbaraśarīraḥ samucchritadigdhabhīṣaṇagadāpāṇirudyatakāladaṇḍa iva kṛtānto 'trabhavatīṃ pāñcālarājatanayāmitastataḥ parimārgamāṇa ita evābhivartate /
children.translated_text: [Chamberlain:] Save yourselves, save yourselves, great king! This wicked wretch of the <s>Kaurava</s> clan, his garments and body reddened by the anointing of blood, with a raised mace smeared with venom, terrible, like <s>Kṛtānta</s> (Death) with uplifted staff of doom, is searching here and there for the revered daughter of the <s>Pāñcāla</s> king, and is approaching this way!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
hā daiva te nirṇayo jātaḥ / hā gāṇḍīvadhanvan* /iti muhyati**
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Alas! Fate has rendered its verdict. Alas, O wielder of the <s>Gāṇḍīva</s> bow! *He faints*

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_193}hā ajjautta hā mama saaṃvarasaaṃgāhadullalida piaṃ bhāduaṃ aṇugadosi ṇa uṇa mahārāaṃ imaṃ dāsajaṇaṃ a* /iti mohamupagatā**
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] [Prakrit] [Falls into a faint.] Alas, noble husband! Alas, my dear brother, fondly raised at my own <s>svayaṃvara</s> (self-choice ceremony)! You have followed [him in death], but not the great king, nor this servant-woman!

children.text: SktCh_193: hā āryaputra hā mama svayaṃvarasvayaṃgrāhadurlalita priyaṃ bhrātaramanugato 'si na punarmahārājamimaṃ dāsajanaṃ ca /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering:] Alas, noble husband! Alas, my dear brother, fondly raised at my own <s>svayaṃvara</s>! You have followed [him in death], but not the great king, nor this servant-woman!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
hā vatsa savyasācinhā trilocanāṅganiṣpeṣamalla hā nivātakavacoddharaṇaniṣkaṇṭakīkṛtāmaraloka hā badaryāśramamunidvitīyatāpasa hā droṇācāryapriyaśiṣya hā astraśikṣābalaparitoṣitagāṅgeya hā rādheyakulakamalinīprāleyavarṣa hā gandharvanirvāsitaduryodhana hā pāṇḍavakulakamalinīrājahaṃsa

children.translated_text: [Verse 6.34]

children.text: tāṃ vatsalāmanabhivādya vinītamambāṃ $ gāḍhaṃ ca māmanupaguhya mayāpyanuktaḥ &
children.translated_text: Without bowing to that tender, modest mother, and without embracing me tightly, and without my having spoken to you,

children.text: etāṃ svayaṃvaravadhūṃ dayitāmadṛṣṭvā ē̃ dīrghapravāsamayi tāta kathaṃ gato 'si // 6.34 //
children.translated_text: without seeing this beloved bride of the <s>svayaṃvara</s> — how, dear child, have you gone on this long journey? (6.34)

[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Alas, dear child <s>Savyasācin</s> (<s>Arjuna</s>)! Alas, wrestler who crushed the body of <s>Trilocana</s> (<s>Śiva</s>)! Alas, you who cleared the world of the gods by uprooting the <s>Nivātakavacas</s>! Alas, ascetic companion of the sages at the <s>Badarī</s> hermitage! Alas, beloved pupil of teacher <s>Droṇa</s>! Alas, you who gratified <s>Gāṅgeya</s> (<s>Bhīṣma</s>) with the strength of your weapon-training! Alas, frost-rain upon the lotus-pond of <s>Rādheya</s>'s (<s>Karṇa</s>'s) clan! Alas, you who expelled <s>Duryodhana</s> from the <s>Gandharvas</s>! Alas, royal swan of the lotus-pond of the <s>Pāṇḍava</s> dynasty!
[He falls into a faint.]

children.text:
&kañcukī&:
bhoḥ kaṣṭam / eṣa durātmā kauravādhamo yatheṣṭamita evābhivartate / sarvathā saṃpratyayameva kālocitaḥ pratīkāraḥ / citāsamīpamupanayāmyatrabhavatīṃ pāñcālarājatanayām / ahamapyevamevānugacchāmi* /ceṭīṃ prati**
bhadre tvamapi devyā bhrātaraṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ nakulasahadevau vāvāpnuhi / atha vaivamavasthite mahārāje 'stamitayorbhīmārjunayoḥ kuto 'tra paritrāṇāśā /
children.translated_text: [<s>Kañcukī</s>:] Alas, how terrible! This wicked, basest of <s>Kauravas</s> is approaching at will from this very direction. In every way, now this alone is the remedy befitting the time. I shall lead the princess of <s>Pāñcāla</s> to the vicinity of the funeral pyre. I too shall follow in the same manner. [To the maidservant.] Good woman, you too should find either the queen's brother <s>Dhṛṣṭadyumna</s>, or <s>Nakula</s> and <s>Sahadeva</s>. Or rather, in this state of the great king [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>], with both <s>Bhīma</s> and <s>Arjuna</s> fallen, where is there hope of rescue?
[Maidservant:] [Prakrit] Save us, save us, noble ones!
[Sanskrit rendering:] Save us, save us, noble ones!
[Commotion behind the curtain.]

children.text: bho bhoḥ samantapañcakasaṃcāriṇaḥ kṣatajāsavamattayakṣarākṣasapiśācabhūtavetālakaṅkagṛdhrajambukolūkavāyasabhūyiṣṭhā viralayodhapuruṣāḥ kṛtamasmaddarśanatrāsena / kathayata kasminnuddeśe yājñasenī saṃnihiteti / kathayāmyupalakṣaṇaṃ tasyāḥ /

children.translated_text: [Verse 6.35]

children.text: ūrū kareṇa parighaṭṭayataḥ salīlaṃ $ duryodhanasya purato 'pahṛtāmbarā yā &
children.translated_text: She whose garment was torn off before <s>Duryodhana</s>, while he playfully slapped his thigh with his hand,

children.text: duḥśāsanena kacakarṣaṇabhinnamauliḥ ē̃ sā draupadī kathayata kva punaḥ pradeśe // 6.35 //
children.translated_text: she whose tiara was broken by the hair-dragging of <s>Duḥśāsana</s> — that <s>Draupadī</s>, tell me, in what place is she? (6.35)

Ho! Ho! You who move about in <s>Samantapañcaka</s> — <s>Yakṣas</s>, <s>Rākṣasas</s>, <s>Piśācas</s>, ghosts, and <s>Vetālas</s> drunk on the wine of blood, crows, vultures, herons, owls, and ravens in abundance, with few living warriors remaining — enough of your fear at seeing us! Tell us in which place <s>Yājñasenī</s> (<s>Draupadī</s>) is! I shall describe her identifying marks:

children.text:
&kañcukī&:
hā devi yajñavedisaṃbhave paribhūyase saṃpratyanāthā kurukulakalaṅkena /
children.translated_text: [<s>Kañcukī</s>:] Alas, queen born from the sacrificial altar! Now, without a protector, you are being outraged by the disgrace of the <s>Kuru</s> clan!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
*sahasotthāya sāvaṣṭambham**
pāñcāli na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyam* /sasaṃbhramam**
kaḥ ko 'tra bhoḥ / saniṣaṅgaṃ me dhanurupanaya / durātmanduryodhanahataka āgacchāgaccha / apanayāmi te gadākauśalasaṃbhṛtaṃ bhujadarpaṃ śilīmukhāsāreṇa / anyacca re kurukulāṅgāra

children.translated_text: [Verse 6.36]

children.text: priyamanujamapaśyaṃstaṃ jarāsaṃdhamallaṃ $ kupitaharakirātāyodhinaṃ taṃ ca vatsam &
children.translated_text: Not seeing my dear brother, that wrestler of <s>Jarāsandha</s>, and that dear son who fought the angry <s>Hara</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) in the guise of a <s>Kirāta</s> (hunter),

children.text: tvamiva kaṭhinacetāḥ prāṇituṃ nāsmi śakto ē̃ nanu punarapahartuṃ bāṇavarṣaistavāsūn // 6.36 //
children.translated_text: I am unable to live, hard-hearted as you — but I am able to take away your life-breaths with showers of arrows! (6.36)

[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] [Suddenly rising with determination.] <s>Pāñcālī</s>, do not fear, do not fear! [With agitation.] Who is there? Ho! Bring me my bow with its quiver! Wretched <s>Duryodhana</s>, villain, come, come! I shall destroy the pride of your arms, nourished by skill with the mace, with a shower of arrows! And furthermore, you firebrand of the <s>Kuru</s> clan —
[Then enters <s>Bhīmasena</s>, mace in hand, his entire body drenched in blood.]

children.text:
&bhīmasenaḥ&:
*uddhataṃ parikrāman**
bho bhoḥ samantapañcakasaṃcāriṇaḥ sainikāḥ ko 'yamāvegaḥ /

children.translated_text: [Verse 6.37]

children.text: nāhaṃ rakṣo na bhūto ripurudhirajalaplāvitāṅgaḥ prakāmaṃ $ nistīrṇorupratijñājalanidhigahanaḥ krodhanaḥ kṣatriyo 'smi &
children.translated_text: I am no <s>Rakṣas</s> (demon), no ghost — with my body fully drenched in the enemy's blood, having crossed the deep ocean of my great vow, I am an angry <s>Kṣatriya</s>!

children.text: bho bho rājanyavīrāḥ samaraśikhiśikhādagdhaśeṣāḥ kṛtaṃ va- ē̃ strāsenānena līnairhatakarituragāntarhitairāsyate yat // 6.37 //
children.translated_text: Ho! Ho! Royal heroes, remnants left scorched by the fire of battle — enough of this fear-stricken hiding among slain elephants and horses by which you are seated concealed! (6.37)
[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] [Striding about with fury.] Ho! Ho! You soldiers moving about in <s>Samantapañcaka</s> — what is this commotion?
Let you all tell me — in which place does the princess of <s>Pāñcāla</s> stand?
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] [Prakrit] [Regaining consciousness.] Let the great king save us, save us!
[Sanskrit rendering:] Let the great king save us, save us!

children.text:
&kañcukī&:
devi pāṇḍusnuṣe uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha / saṃprati jhaṭiti citāpraveśa eva śreyān /
children.translated_text: [<s>Kañcukī</s>:] Queen, daughter-in-law of <s>Pāṇḍu</s>, arise, arise! Now, immediately entering the funeral pyre is the best course.

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_196}*sahasotthāya**
kahaṃ ṇa saṃbhāvemi ajja bi cidāsamībaṃ /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] [Prakrit] [Rising suddenly.] How can I not even now imagine the vicinity of the pyre!
[Sanskrit rendering:] How can I not even now conceive of approaching the funeral pyre!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
kaḥ ko 'tra bhoḥ / saniṣaṅgaṃ dhanurupanaya / kathaṃ na kaścitparijanaḥ / bhavatu / bāhuyuddhenaiva durātmānaṃ gāḍhamāliṅgya jvalanamabhipātayāmi* /parikaraṃ badhnāti**
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Who is there? Ho! Bring me my bow with its quiver! What, is there no attendant? Very well! By wrestling alone, I shall seize that wretched villain <s>Duryodhana</s> in a tight embrace and hurl him into the fire! [He girds himself.]

children.text:
&kañcukī&:
devi pāṇḍusnuṣe saṃyamyantāmidānīṃ nayanoparodhino duḥśāsanāvakṛṣṭā mūrdhajāḥ / astamitā saṃprati pratīkārāśā / citāsamīpameva drutataraṃ saṃbhāvaya /
children.translated_text: [<s>Kañcukī</s>:] Queen, daughter-in-law of <s>Pāṇḍu</s>, now let the locks of hair, dragged by <s>Duḥśāsana</s> and obstructing your eyes, be composed! The hope of rescue has now set. Hasten quickly toward the funeral pyre.

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
kṛṣṇe na khalvanihate tasmindurātmani duryodhane saṃhartavyāḥ keśāḥ /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] <s>Kṛṣṇā</s> (<s>Draupadī</s>), surely the hair must not be bound up until that villain <s>Duryodhana</s> has been killed!

children.text:
&bhīmasenaḥ&:
pāñcāli na khalu mayi jīvati saṃhartavyā duḥśāsanavilulitā veṇirātmapāṇibhyām / tiṣṭhatu tiṣṭhatu / svayamevāhaṃ saṃharāmi /
children.translated_text: [<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] <s>Pāñcālī</s>, surely while I live, the braid disheveled by <s>Duḥśāsana</s> must not be bound by your own hands! Wait, wait! I myself shall bind it!
[<s>Draupadī</s> shrinks back in fear.]

children.text:
&bhīmasenaḥ&:
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bhīru kvādhunā gamyate* /iti keśeṣu grahītumicchati**
children.translated_text: [<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] Stop, stop, timid one! Where do you go now? [He tries to grasp her hair.]
[Verse 6.38]
You who have from childhood daily caused offenses, intoxicated with the strength of your arms, slayer of princes —

children.text: āsādya me 'ntaramidaṃ bhujapañjarasya ē̃ jīvanprayāsi na padātpadamadya pāpa // 6.38 //
children.translated_text: having come within this cage of my arms, you shall not depart alive even a single step today, sinner! (6.38)
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] [Rushing to embrace <s>Bhīma</s>.] Villain! Enemy of <s>Bhīma</s> and <s>Arjuna</s>! Wretched <s>Suyodhana</s>!
[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] Ah! How is it that the noble one, mistaking me for <s>Suyodhana</s>, embraces me mercilessly in his anger!

children.text:
&kañcukī&:
*nirūpya saharṣam**
mahārāja vañcyase / ayaṃ khalvāyuṣmānbhīmasenaḥ suyodhanakṣatajāruṇīkṛtasakalaśarīrāmbaro durlakṣavyaktiḥ / alamadhunā saṃdehena /
children.translated_text: [<s>Kañcukī</s>:] [Looking carefully, with joy.] Great king, you are deceived! This is indeed the venerable <s>Bhīmasena</s>, whose entire body and garments are reddened with the blood of <s>Suyodhana</s>, making him difficult to recognize! Enough now with doubt!

children.text:
&ceṭī&:
{Pkt_197}*draupadīmāliṅgya**
devi ṇivattīadu ṇivattīadu / eso kkhu pūridapaḍiṇṇābhāro ṇāho de veṇīsaṃhāraṃ kāduṃ tumaṃ evva aṇṇesadi /
children.translated_text: [Maidservant:] [Prakrit] [Embracing <s>Draupadī</s>.] Queen, turn back, turn back! This is indeed your lord, having fulfilled his vow, searching for you to perform the binding of the braid (<s>veṇīsaṃhāra</s>)!

children.text: SktCh_197: devi nivṛtyatāṃ nivṛtyatām / eṣa khalu pūritapratijñābhāro nāthaste veṇīsaṃhāraṃ kartuṃ tvāmevānviṣyati /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering:] Queen, turn back, turn back! This is indeed your lord, having fulfilled his vow, searching for you to perform the <s>veṇīsaṃhāra</s> (binding of the braid)!
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] [Prakrit] Dear girl, are you consoling me with false words?
[Sanskrit rendering:] Dear girl, are you consoling me with false words?
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] <s>Jayaṃdhara</s>, what do you say? This is not the man-hating villain <s>Duryodhana</s>?

children.text:
&bhīmasenaḥ&:
deva ajātaśatro bhīmārjunaguro kuto 'dyāpi duryodhanahatakaḥ / mayā hi tasya durātmanaḥ pāṇḍukulaparibhāvinaḥ

children.translated_text: [Verse 6.39]

children.text: bhūmau kṣiptaṃ śarīraṃ nihitamidamasṛkcandanābhaṃ nijāṅge $ lakṣmīrārye niṣaṇṇā caturudadhipayaḥsīmayā sārdhamurvyā &
children.translated_text: His body has been cast upon the ground; this [blood] like sandalwood-paste has been smeared on my limbs; the goddess <s>Lakṣmī</s> (sovereignty) sits with the noble one, together with the earth bounded by the four oceans;

children.text: bhṛtyā mitrāṇi yodhāḥ kurukulamakhilaṃ dagdhametadraṇāgnau ē̃ nāmaikaṃ yadbravīṣi kṣitipa tadadhunā dhārtarāṣṭrasya śeṣam // 6.39 //
children.translated_text: servants, friends, warriors — the entire <s>Kuru</s> clan has been burnt in this fire of war. What alone remains of the son of <s>Dhṛtarāṣṭra</s>, that single thing, O king, is what you now speak of [i.e., his name alone]. (6.39)

[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] Sire, <s>Ajātaśatru</s> (Yudhiṣṭhira), elder of <s>Bhīma</s> and <s>Arjuna</s> — whence still a villain <s>Duryodhana</s>? For by me, that wicked one who outraged the <s>Pāṇḍu</s> clan —
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s> slowly releases <s>Bhīma</s>, gazes at him, and wipes away his tears.]
[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] [Falling at his feet.] Victory to the noble one!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
vatsa bāṣpajalāntaritanayanatvānna paśyāmi te mukhacandram / tatkathaya kaccijjīvati bhavānsamaṃ kirīṭinā /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Child, because my eyes are veiled by a flood of tears, I cannot see the moon of your face. Then tell me — do you live, together with <s>Kirīṭin</s> (<s>Arjuna</s>)?
[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] With the entire enemy side slain, and with you, O lord of men, alive — <s>Bhīma</s> and <s>Arjuna</s> live!
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] [Embracing him tightly again.]

children.text:
VERSE_6.40
riporāstāṃ tāvannidhanamidamākhyāhi śataśaḥ $ priyo bhrātā satyaṃ tvamasi mama yo 'sau bakaripuḥ &
children.translated_text: [Verse 6.40] Let the death of the enemy stand aside for now — tell me this a hundred times: truly, you are my dear brother, that slayer of <s>Baka</s>!
[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] Noble one, I am he!
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:]
[Verse 6.40 continued]

children.text: jarāsaṃdhasyoraḥsarasi rudhirāsārasalile ē̃ taṭāghātakrīḍālalitamakaraḥ saṃyati bhavān // 6.40 //
children.translated_text: You who in the lake of <s>Jarāsandha</s>'s chest, with its waters of flowing blood, sported as a playful crocodile with blows upon the shore — are you [truly] here in battle? (6.40)

children.text:
&bhīmasenaḥ&:
ārya sa evāham / tanmuñcatu māmāryaḥ kṣaṇamekam /
children.translated_text: [<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] Noble one, I am that very one! Now let the noble one release me for just a moment.
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] What else remains to be done?

children.text:
&bhīmasenaḥ&:
ārya sumahadavaśiṣṭam / saṃyacchāmi tāvadanena suyodhanaśoṇitokṣitena pāṇinā pāñcālyā duḥśāsanāvakṛṣṭaṃ keśahastam /
children.translated_text: [<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] Noble one, a very great thing remains! Let me now bind with this hand, drenched in the blood of <s>Suyodhana</s>, the mass of hair of the princess of <s>Pāñcāla</s>, which was dragged by <s>Duḥśāsana</s>!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
satvaraṃ gacchatu bhavān / anubhavatu tapasvinī veṇīsaṃhāramahotsavam /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Let him go quickly! Let the long-suffering woman enjoy the great festival of the <s>veṇīsaṃhāra</s> (binding of the braid)!

children.text:
&bhīmasenaḥ&:
*draupadīmupasṛtya**
devi pāñcālarājatanaye diṣṭyā vardhase ripukulakṣayeṇa / alamalamevaṃvidhaṃ māmālokya trāsena /

children.translated_text: [Verse 6.40]

children.text: kṛṣṭā yenāsi rājñāṃ sadasi nṛpaśunā tena duḥśāsanena $ styānānyetāni tasya spṛśa mama karayoḥ pītaśeṣāṇyasṛñji &
children.translated_text: By that dog-among-kings <s>Duḥśāsana</s>, by whom you were dragged in the assembly of kings — touch on my hands these clotted remnants of his blood, the last remains of what I have drunk;

children.text: kānte rājñaḥ kurūṇāmapi sarasamidaṃ madgadācūrṇitoro- ē̃ raṅge 'ṅge 'sṛṅniṣaktaṃ tava paribhavajasyānalasyopaśāntyai // 6.40 //
children.translated_text: O beloved, and this [blood] of the king of the <s>Kurus</s>, whose chest was crushed by my mace, fresh upon my body — smear it [on your hair] for the quenching of the fire born of your humiliation. (6.40)

[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] [Approaching <s>Draupadī</s>.] Queen, daughter of the <s>Pāñcāla</s> king, blessed are you by the destruction of the enemy clan! Enough, enough of being frightened by seeing me in this state.

children.text: buddhimatike kva sā saṃprati bhānumatī yopahasati pāṇḍavadārān / bhavati yajñavedisaṃbhave yājñaseni /
children.translated_text: Clever woman, where is that <s>Bhānumatī</s> now, who mocked the wives of the <s>Pāṇḍavas</s>? While you, O <s>Yājñasenī</s>, are born from the sacrificial altar!
[<s>Draupadī</s>:] [Prakrit] Let the lord command.
[Sanskrit rendering:] Let the lord command.

children.text: smarati bhavatī yanmayoktam* /cañcadbhujetyādiSee stanza 1.21. pūrvoktaṃ paṭhati**
children.translated_text: Does my lady remember what I said? [He recites the earlier verse beginning 'With trembling arms...' (See stanza 1.21).]
[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:]

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_200}ṇāha ṇa kevalaṃ sumarāmi / aṇuhavāmi a ṇāhassa pasādeṇa /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] [Prakrit] Lord, I not only remember — I experience it too, by the lord's grace.

children.text: SktCh_200: nātha na kevalaṃ smarāmi / anubhavāmi ca nāthasya prasādena /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering:] Lord, I not only remember — I experience it too, by the lord's grace.
[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:] [Shaking the braid.] My lady, now let this braid, which was disheveled by <s>Duḥśāsana</s> — this dark night of doom for the clan of <s>Dhṛtarāṣṭra</s> — be bound up!

children.text:
&draupadī&:
{Pkt_201}ṇāha visumaridamhi edaṃ vābāraṃ / ṇāhassa pasāeṇa puṇo bi sikkhissaṃ /
children.translated_text: [<s>Draupadī</s>:] [Prakrit] Lord, I have forgotten how to do this. By the lord's grace, I shall learn again.

children.text: SktCh_201: nātha vismṛtāsmyetaṃ vyāpāram / nāthasya prasādena punarapi śikṣiṣye /
children.translated_text: [Sanskrit rendering:] Lord, I have forgotten this task. By the lord's grace, I shall learn again.
[<s>Bhīmasena</s> binds the braid.]
[Behind the curtain:]
[Verse 6.42]

children.text: krodhāndhairyasya mokṣātkṣatanarapatibhiḥ pāṇḍuputraiḥ kṛtāni $ pratyāśaṃ muktakeśānyatulabhujabalaiḥ pārthivāntaḥpurāṇi &
children.translated_text: The sons of <s>Pāṇḍu</s>, wounded kings, whose anger let loose [their fury], with incomparable arm-strength caused the inner chambers of kings to unbind their hair in anticipation [of widowhood];

children.text: kṛṣṇāyāḥ keśapāśaḥ kupitayamasakho dhūmaketuḥ kurūṇāṃ ē̃ so 'yaṃ baddhaḥ prajānāṃ viramatu nidhanaṃ svasti rājñāṃ kulebhyaḥ // 6.42 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇā</s>'s (<s>Draupadī</s>'s) braid, which was the fiery comet for the <s>Kurus</s>, accompanied by angry <s>Yama</s> (Death) — that braid is now bound! Let the destruction of people cease! May well-being attend the families of kings! (6.42)
May well-being attend the royal families, remnants left scorched by the fire of the great battle!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
devi eṣa te veṇīsaṃhāro 'bhinandyate nabhastalasaṃcāriṇā siddhajanena /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] Queen, this binding of your braid (<s>veṇīsaṃhāra</s>) is celebrated by the <s>Siddha</s> hosts moving in the sky!
[Then enter <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> and <s>Arjuna</s>.]

children.text:
&kṛṣṇaḥ&:
*yudhiṣṭhiramupagamya**
vijayatāṃ nihatasakalārātimaṇḍalaḥ sānujaḥ pāṇḍavakulacandramā mahārājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ /
children.translated_text: [<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>:] [Approaching <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>.] Victory to the great king <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>, the moon of the <s>Pāṇḍava</s> dynasty, together with his brothers, who has destroyed the entire host of enemies!
[<s>Arjuna</s>:] Victory to the noble one!

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
*vilokya**
aye bhagavānpuṇḍarīkākṣo vatsaśca kirīṭī / bhagavannabhivādaye* /kirīṭinaṃ prati**
ehyehi vatsa /
children.translated_text: [<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] [Looking.] Ah, it is the blessed Lotus-eyed One (<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>) and the dear child <s>Kirīṭin</s> (<s>Arjuna</s>)! Lord, I salute you! [To <s>Arjuna</s>.] Come, come, dear child!
[<s>Arjuna</s> bows.]

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
*vāsudevaṃ prati**
deva kutastasya vijayādanyadyasya bhagavānpurāṇapuruṣo nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ maṅgalānyāśāste /

children.translated_text: [Verse 6.43]
Him whose form was manifested from the great primordial disturbance, the virtuous one, the cause of the arising and destruction of beings —

children.text: ajamamaramacintyaṃ cintayitvāpi na tvāṃ ē̃ bhavati jagati duḥkhī kiṃ punardeva dṛṣṭvā // 6.43 //
children.translated_text: Having contemplated You — the unborn, immortal, inconceivable one — no one in this world remains sorrowful; how much more so, O Lord, upon seeing You! (6.43)
[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:] [To <s>Vāsudeva</s>.] Lord, whence any doubt of his victory, when the blessed primeval being <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> himself wishes him well?

*Embracing <s>Arjuna</s>*
Child, embrace me!
[Verse 6.44]

children.text: vyāso 'yaṃ bhagavānamī ca munayo vālmīkirāmādayo $ dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhāśca sainyapatayo mādrīsutādhiṣṭhitāḥ &
children.translated_text: Here is the venerable <s>Vyāsa</s>, here are these sages — <s>Vālmīki</s>, <s>Rāma</s>, and others — and the army commanders led by <s>Dhṛṣṭadyumna</s>, accompanied by the sons of <s>Mādrī</s>,

children.text: prāptā māgadhamatsyayādavakulairājñāvidheyaiḥ samaṃ ē̃ skandhottambhitatīrthavārikalaśā rājyābhiṣekāya te // 6.44 //
children.translated_text: arrived together with the obedient kings of the <s>Māgadha</s>, <s>Matsya</s>, and <s>Yādava</s> clans, bearing on their shoulders water-pots filled with sacred water from holy places — for your royal consecration. (6.44)

[<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>:]
Great King <s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>,

children.text: ahaṃ punardurātmanā cārvākeṇa viprakṛtaṃ bhavantamupalabhyārjunena saha tvaritataramāyātaḥ /
children.translated_text: And I, having learned that you were insulted by the wicked <s>Cārvāka</s>, came here in haste together with <s>Arjuna</s>.

[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:]
What! We were thus deceived by the <s>Rākṣasa</s> (demon) <s>Cārvāka</s>!

children.text:
&bhīmasenaḥ&:
*saroṣam**
kvāsau dhārtarāṣṭrasakhā puṇyajanāpasado yenāryasya mahāṃścittavibhramaḥ kṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text:
[<s>Bhīmasena</s>:]
*Angrily*
Where is that wretch, that disgrace among the <s>Puṇyajanas</s> (Rākṣasas), that friend of <s>Dhārtarāṣṭra</s> (<s>Duryodhana</s>), by whom such great mental confusion was caused to the noble one?

children.text:
&kṛṣṇaḥ&:
nigṛhītaḥ sa durātmā nakulena / tatkathaya mahārāja kimasmātparaṃ samīhitaṃ saṃpādayāmi /
children.translated_text:
[<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>:]
That wicked one has been seized by <s>Nakula</s>. So tell me, Great King, what further desire of yours shall I fulfil?

children.text:
&yudhiṣṭhiraḥ&:
evaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa na kiṃcinna dadāti bhagavānprasannaḥ / ahaṃ tu puruṣasādhāraṇayā buddhyā saṃtuṣyāmi / na khalvataḥ paramabhyarthayituṃ kṣamaḥ / paśyatu devaḥ /

children.translated_text: [Verse 6.45]

children.text: krodhāndhaiḥ sakalaṃ hataṃ ripukulaṃ pañcākṣatāste vayaṃ $ pāñcālyā mama durnayopajanitastīrṇo nikārārṇavaḥ &
children.translated_text: The entire enemy clan has been slain by those blinded with rage, and we five are unharmed; the ocean of humiliation born of <s>Pāñcālī</s>'s (Draupadī's) mistreatment due to my folly has been crossed;

children.text: tvaṃ devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ sukṛtinaṃ māmādṛto bhāṣase ē̃ kiṃ nāmānyadataḥ paraṃ bhagavato yāce prasannādaham // 6.45 //
children.translated_text: You, the Lord, <s>Puruṣottama</s> (Supreme Being), address me as one of good fortune — what else, then, could I ask from the blessed Lord who is pleased? (6.45)

[<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s>:]
O lotus-eyed one (<s>Puṇḍarīkākṣa</s>), there is nothing that the blessed Lord does not give when pleased. But I am satisfied with the understanding common to all men. Indeed, I am not worthy to ask for more than this. Let the Lord see:
[Verse 6.46]

children.text: akṛpaṇamarukśrāntaṃ jīvyājjanaḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ $ bhavatu bhagavanbhaktirdvaitaṃ vinā puruṣottame &
children.translated_text: May people live a full human lifespan — generous, unwearied in spirit; may there be devotion to <s>Puruṣottama</s> (the Supreme Being), the blessed Lord, without duality;

children.text: dayitabhuvano vidvadbandhurguṇeṣu viśeṣavi- ē̃ tsatatasukṛtī bhūyādbhūpaḥ prasādhitamaṇḍalaḥ // 6.46 //
children.translated_text: may the king, with his realm well-governed, be one who cherishes the earth, is a friend to the learned, discerning in virtues, and ever meritorious. (6.46)
Nevertheless, if the blessed Lord is especially pleased, then let this be granted:
[Verse 6.47]

children.text: avanimavanipālāḥ pāntu vṛṣṭiṃ vidhattāṃ $ jagati jaladharālī śasyapūrṇāstu bhūmiḥ &
children.translated_text: May the kings protect the earth; may the array of rain-clouds bestow rain; may the land be full of crops;

children.text: tvayi muranarakārau bhaktiradvaitayogā- ē̃ dbhavatu mama sudīrghaṃ havyamaśnantu devāḥ // 6.47 //
children.translated_text: may my devotion to You — the slayer of <s>Mura</s> and <s>Naraka</s> — be of non-dual union; and for a long time, may the gods partake of the sacrificial offerings. (6.47)
And furthermore:

[<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>:]
So be it.
*All exit.*

children.text:
iti ṣaṣṭho 'ṅkaḥ /

samāptamidaṃ veṇīsaṃhāraṃ nāma nāṭakam /
children.translated_text:
Thus ends the sixth act.

Thus is completed the drama named <s>Veṇīsaṃhāra</s> (The Braiding of the Braid).

children.text: idaṃ ca vidagdhasnigdhaviyogadurmanasā vipralapitaṃ tena kavinā /
children.translated_text: And this was composed by that poet, whose heart was distressed by separation from a beloved, wise, and tender friend:
Those royal swans, addicted to the pleasures of poetry, conversation, and fine speech, are gone;

children.text: stā goṣṭhyaḥ kṣayamāgatā guṇalavaślāghyāstu vācaḥ satām /
children.translated_text: those assemblies have perished; praiseworthy even for a trace of merit are the words of the virtuous;
the speech of poets — adorned with figures, graceful with <s>rasa</s> (aesthetic sentiment), clear, and sweet in form —

children.text: prāptā nāśamayaṃ tu bhūmivalaye jīyātprabandho mahān //
children.translated_text: has met with destruction. But may this great literary work endure upon the surface of the earth!
